spec_features.spec_quote: Stop at the category's `turn_budget` or when the model emits the `give_up` sentinel
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:470 `for turn_index in range(task.turn_budget):` bounds the agent loop; the loop ends (stop_reason defaults to 'budget_exhausted', set at line 446 and line 511). turn_budget originates from DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS in config.py:39-44 and is carried on Task (harness.py:187, set in tasks/generate.py:97/158/193/232/295). The give_up branch at harness.py:510 `gave_up = give_up_sentinel in (result.text or '')` and harness.py:521-522 `if gave_up: stop_reason='give_up'; break` actually breaks the loop. Both stop conditions are enforced end-to-end (run.py:71 passes cfg.give_up_sentinel into run_rollout).
spec_features.notes: Both halves of the claim (turn cap AND give_up sentinel) are genuinely checked and break/bound execution. This is a real enforced stop, but the magnitude/treatment is purely a turn-count loop bound.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Otherwise keep working until the tests pass. (SYSTEM_PROMPT, harness.py:42) — frames the budget as a task/efficiency bound, no welfare reason in code

spec_features.spec_quote: define a `give_up` sentinel the model may but need not use
spec_features.evidence: give_up_sentinel='<GIVE_UP>' (config.py:69) is rendered into the SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:42 mentions emitting 'the exact sentinel {sentinel} on its own line to stop'; formatted at harness.py:457). It is detected at harness.py:510 (`give_up_sentinel in result.text`) and honored at harness.py:521-522 with `break`, ending the rollout early; stop_reason recorded as 'give_up' (harness.py:522,530). The prompt also explicitly says the model 'may emit' it (optional, 'may but need not use').
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to subject AND a working dispatch/break that stops the loop. Fully wired and honored as a stop.
